question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **At sea**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Feeling confused or perplexed. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"At sea"** means feeling confused, perplexed, or unsure about something. It is often used to describe a state of uncertainty or being lost. (भ्रमित या असमंजस की स्थिति में होना) • **Example:** When she started her new job, she felt completely at sea with all the unfamiliar tasks. • The correct meaning of this idiom is **"Feeling confused or perplexed"** (भ्रमित या उलझन में). • **Example:** The student was at sea during the complex math lecture. • Hence, we can conclude that the correct answer is **Option 4**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Experiencing luck** (सौभाग्य का अनुभव करना): Refers to being fortunate or having good luck. • **Example:** She was experiencing luck when she won the lottery. • **Option 2: Travelling abroad** (विदेश यात्रा करना): Refers to going to another country for travel or other purposes. • **Example:** He is travelling abroad for a business conference. • **Option 3: Gaining sudden wealth** (अचानक धन प्राप्त करना): Refers to becoming rich unexpectedly or in a short period of time. • **Example:** Winning the jackpot meant gaining sudden wealth for the family. 3d:Tb11, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
